cohort_total_n_excerpt: 250 PCa patients and 500 controls were enrolled in this case-control study.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: alcohol consumption (OR=1.97, 95% CI: 1.33-2.90), red meat consumption (OR=1.74, 95% CI: 1.20-2.52), barbecued (OR=2.29, 95% CI: 1.11-4.73) or fried (OR=2.35, 95% CI: 1.24-4.43) foods were related with increased PCa risk.
estimate_classifications.reason: The alcohol estimate concerns overall PCa risk, with no aggressive subtype specified.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Green vegetables and green tea were associated with a decreased risk of PCa (OR=0.39, 95% CI: 0.28-0.53; OR=0.59, 95% CI: 0.40-0.87, respectively).
estimate_classifications.reason: The green tea estimate concerns overall PCa risk, with no aggressive subtype specified.
